manifest.rationale: 100000 chosen after the disclosed Doors/s4 sweep, then applied uniformly to all 34 cases. This is an internal follow-up evaluation, not an independent holdout. All runs use the same 15s/2GiB limits, demand formulas, saturated resource keys and shared threshold search. Counts controls are reused: prior saturated-resource counts for all 16 overlays; prior demand counts for 18 resource-free originals (identical channels and recurrence, without the vacuous empty-resource key wrapper). Do not attribute tiny timing changes against these reused controls to a strict paired simultaneous measurement. No API/external reruns.
